observability.metrics: No telemetry upload. UI progress is process-local and bounded to verified download byte counts.

errorSemantics: HTTP 204 and no newer semantic version return current; network, manifest or endpoint failures return unavailable without blocking startup, navigation, connection or third-party installation.
The native updater verifies the mandatory embedded public-key signature before shutdown. Invalid signatures, invalid platform entries and version mismatch fail closed.
Only the updater operation is serialized. It does not acquire tool activation, vendor installation, account, model or billing locks.

After verified download the updater drops its normal operation permit, requests cooperative shutdown, drains registered runtimes, installs, and relaunches where the platform requires it. If installation fails after shutdown starts, it attempts to relaunch the current application and never claims success.
Cancellation caused by app quit before verified download is safe; no renderer promise or global modal keeps the app alive.

contracts.authorization: Anonymous HTTPS GET/HEAD to one compiled first-party channel. No account bearer, cookie, API key, caller-selected host or write operation.
contracts.idempotency: A published manifest is immutable for its version and atomically replaces the channel pointer only after all immutable artifacts and detached signatures are present. Removing the pointer disables updates without deleting versioned objects.
contracts.compatibility: Uses the Tauri v2 static JSON shape: one semantic version, optional notes/date and a platforms map containing HTTPS URL plus mandatory signature for supported target triples. HTTP 204 means no update is published.

inputSchema.description: Public fixed-channel read carries no caller data.

platforms.description: Supported target triples mapped to immutable HTTPS URL and detached signature.

observability.correlation: Version, target triple, immutable public URL, size and hash from build and publication receipts.
observability.audit: Atomic publication receipt records previous and next channel hashes without private key material.
observability.metrics: Public read-only endpoint only; no client or account telemetry.

errorSemantics: Unsafe methods return 405; hidden, directory and traversal paths fail closed.
Missing channel pointer returns empty 204 with no-store rather than a fabricated version.
A malformed manifest, unsupported target, non-HTTPS URL, missing signature, downgrade or replayed version is never installable.
Manifest publication is last; partial artifact upload cannot become authoritative.

contracts.compatibility: Version 1 is closed and supports only the pinned DeepSeek Harness source and declared native targets. A changed upstream commit, application ID, signer, target or receipt schema requires a new reviewed contract version or release unit.

Preparation writes private metadata only. It does not publish, upload, mutate the official-byte mirror or claim clean-device installation.

contracts.authorization: One explicit click in the bundled desktop shell while a valid first-party session exists. Native code accepts two compiled line IDs, six closed target IDs and exact current-account model/group bindings. WorkBuddy receives only its dedicated scoped credential through its documented local model catalog; keys remain native and never cross renderer IPC.
contracts.idempotency: Repeated activation reuses the dedicated target token and replaces only receipt-owned fields. WorkBuddy entries are keyed by exact model ID; unrelated entries and user preference fields remain untouched. A same-tool pending encrypted transaction is recovered before a new write.
contracts.compatibility: Wire schema stays version 4. The target enum adds workbuddy. Existing five targets keep desktop-tool-activation@v10 behavior. WorkBuddy accepts both the installed top-level array and documented object wrapper, hot reloads configuration, and requires no helper runtime or forced restart.
